drop_paper: Drop a manuscript here or choose a file
mode_standard_web_tip: Old name for Standard. Generic third-party web pages do not count as citation evidence.
llm_unavailable: No LLM selected. A new run will stop after Resolve: Fetch, Guided Fetch and Verify will not run. Configure and select models for the full workflow.
jury1_lane_tip: Select this to use the provider and model for Jury 1. When it is the only model selected anywhere, it is assigned to both juries automatically.
jury2_lane_tip: Select this to use the provider and model for Jury 2. When it is the only model selected anywhere, it is assigned to both juries automatically. Jury 2 is inactive when its severity is off.
llm_jury1_required: Choose at least one Jury 1 model. Jury 2 cannot run on its own.
llm_invalid_reason: Verify cannot run with this model assignment: {reason}
open_path_unavailable: Windows did not open the file.
open_path_failed: Could not open {path}. You can open it from the run folder. {reason}
skip_manual_checks_tip: Keep automatic retrieval and verification. Waive pending manual Fetch work; sources needing a manual identity decision remain unverified. The decision is recorded in the run.
skip_manual_failed: Automatic manual-task skip stopped: {reason}. The run remains paused for review.
resume_latest_preview: Continue {paper} through Fetch and Verify in a new run. The completed preview remains unchanged.
phase_references_only_done: References-only report complete; Fetch and Verify were not run.
process_interrupted: Analysis interrupted; it can be resumed.
process_stopped_unclean: Stop timed out. The GUI force-closed the worker; saved progress can be recovered once the run is marked recoverable.
summary_lookup_resolved: Callimachus matched this citation to a bibliographic record.
summary_lookup_not_found: The recorded searches found no compatible work.
summary_lookup_identifier_mismatch: A record was found, but its identity does not match the citation.
summary_lookup_unresolved: The recorded searches did not establish a reliable match.
summary_lookup_unverified: The recorded lookup could not verify this bibliographic identity.
summary_resolution_pending: No bibliographic lookup is recorded yet.
summary_fetch_pending: No source acquisition is recorded yet.
summary_acquired_fulltext: Callimachus acquired full text for this source.
summary_acquired_abstract: Callimachus acquired an abstract for this source.
summary_awaiting_manual: No usable text has been acquired yet. Manual action is pending in Guided Fetch.
summary_no_usable_text: No usable text has been acquired for this source.
summary_verification_in_progress: Verification in progress; no final verdict yet
summary_no_verdict: No verification verdict is recorded for this source.
confirm_delete_runs: Permanently delete the selected historical runs and their audit artefacts? This cannot be undone.
select_verify_backends: Select the configured backends and models for the new Verify run.
verify_fork_unavailable: The selected run is no longer completed or available.
verify_backends_unavailable: No valid Verify backends are configured.
verify_fork_process_active: Wait for the active run to finish before creating a new Verify run.
abstract_retry_tip: The abstract remains reusable, but Callimachus will retry full text when possible.
confirm_delete_cache: Remove the selected entries from the reusable cache? Run evidence and user originals will be preserved.
confirm_clear_cache: Clear the reusable cache? Run evidence and user originals will be preserved.
guided_fetch_waiting: Guided Fetch is open: the run remains paused until Proceed.
process_failed_startup: Analysis could not start because its setup or configuration was refused. Review Settings, then try again.
process_failed_pipeline: Analysis stopped because setup, configuration, input data, or a pipeline safety check failed. The run was not completed; review the current phase and Settings before resuming.
process_run_locked: This run is already being processed. Wait for it to finish or stop it safely, then resume.
process_gate_failed: The run did not pass its final completion or audit check. The report is not yet complete and authenticated; review unresolved items before resuming.
process_report_untrusted: The report was not opened because its verification or authenticity could not be confirmed.
process_crashed: Analysis stopped unexpectedly. Its saved progress may still be resumed.
process_failed: Analysis ended unexpectedly. Review the current phase and Settings before trying again.
snapshot_unavailable: Run snapshot is unavailable; Guided Fetch was not opened.
analysis_running_close: A run is still active. Wait until it finishes or reaches a safe pause before closing Callimachus.
language_restart: The selected language will apply on the next launch.
settings_empty: No settings are available in this section.
unsaved_settings: You have unsaved settings changes. Save them before leaving?
signing_key_description: Create the local signing key used to seal audit reports. The private key is never shown in this interface.
resume_latest_older: The latest run cannot be resumed; this will resume: {paper}
resume_latest_crash: Recover and resume the interrupted run: {paper}.
resume_latest_no_history: No previous run is available to resume.
resume_latest_unavailable: The latest run is unavailable and cannot be resumed.
resume_latest_active: The latest run is already active and cannot be resumed.
resume_latest_completed: The latest run is already complete and cannot be resumed.
